items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: I think Pee Wee Russell would have been close except that Kenny is a better clarinet player.

ctx.x: Yeah. And — © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -11-

Wellstood? Yeah. That was a wonderful trio. I didn’t even mind not having a bass player. It only would have gotten in the way. I listen to tapes I play in the car when I’m going someplace, and listen to it and I think damn, that’s good, that’s what we meant. Kenny Davern is a most unusual player. He’s not a Benny Goodman freak. He plays like Kenny Davern. He plays like no one else. I think Pee Wee Russell would have been close except that Kenny is a better clarinet player.
